claims.statement:
For the fixed nonidentity P in BLS12-381 G1 supplied by the challenge and uniform z in the order-r subgroup of GT (identity included), the disclosed classical algorithm returns Q in G2 with the pinned reduced pairing e(P,Q)=z for that exact supplied P 0.3523 (CP-95 lower 0.3337; the production-horizon retention gate is UNMET and both rows are shipped as such) and its complete classical work is at most 2^125.7711 dense-Fp12-multiplication equivalents at the protected C=20000, summed over all processors with no amortisation. The claim covers W_stress 2^125.770322 plus the whole auxiliary total 2^114.815, trap rows included (claim.covers); it clears the live board minimum 125.82 by 0.0489 bits and the 125.8345 legality line by 0.0634. The algorithm solves a = log_g z in GT with g = e(P,Q0) on the twelve-element Frobenius classes, N = (r-1)/12 = 2^251.27 classes, ord_r(p) = 12. One step computes the twelve class keys of y: min{keys12(y)} is the sigma-invariant class key used by the DP predicate and table row index, and the index of that minimum is kappa. Then either y is squared with the labels doubled (three of every eight classes) or y is multiplied by the pre-expanded entry TBL[t][col] = sigma^{-col}(M_t) with the first label increased by U[t][col] = u_t p^{-col} mod r, col = kappa unless row t occurred among the last D=12 multiply steps, then the recorded column is reused. r-1 is factored exactly in factor_r.py and the product re-multiplied: 255 bits, twelve distinct prime factors, each prime by Miller-Rabin; ord_r(p)=12 and p^6 mod r = r-1 gives the unique order-2 element.

TRAPS, THE ABANDON CAP, AND THE EXPECTATION BOUND. Every repeat of a (class, ring) state is a cycle that contains no DP, so it never reports and is a trap whatever its label increment: 1744 joint-state repeats in 1000000 step pairs, 0 zero-increment and 1744 nonzero, one period-20 family at lags 20/40/60/80/100/120/140/160, 164/256 walks repeating inside 400 steps. The shipped trail now really ends at its first DP OR at a hard cap of 128*theta = 2^87 steps, whichever comes first: a capped trail is ABANDONED, its labels discarded and a fresh trail started. measure_v22_ext implements and meters that counter: of 16 fixture trails 2 trapped on a cycle before any DP, all 2 abandoned at exactly the cap (measured delay mean 4096 = the cap, variance 0) and the force-admission control -- same state, same ring, no cap -- ran 2x cap steps with zero DPs, so the cap is deterministic: P(a trail runs past it) = 0 by construction and no exp(-128) tail is used. The waste row is cap x rate x step price = 2^87 x 1.0960 = 1.696e+26 reference units per abandon, charged per event. The expectation bound is derived, not assumed: the guard only REFINES the state (y -> (y, ring)), so a joint repeat requires an element repeat and the joint collision count is at most the element count -- measured over 159200 step pairs, joint 3816 <= guarded element 55133 <= unguarded element 130634 -- hence Lambda = S^2/(2(r-1)) = 0.0539 is an UPPER bound for the guarded walk (iid value valid by monotonicity), with Markov on the census-measured E = 0.3488 repeats per walk as a hypothesis-free cross-check. Charged: C = ceil(4 Lambda / 1e-9) = 215440264 events x (DP lookup 0.0210 + detector probe and 112-byte compare 0.0210 + restart of two GT exponentiations 1526.19 + the cap waste) = 169605522507342626450046976.0 per event, total 2^114.815 reference units as aux.trap_charge inside the claim, re-summed by integer assert.

SUCCESS CARRIES THE GUARDED RETENTION. Lambda = S^2(1-f^2)/(2 mu N) = 0.5049381183, 1 - exp(-Lambda) = 0.3964571, S = 2^125.821225, mu = 11/10, f = 3/8. The v19 retention 0.895833 was an EXTRACT of a v18-era JSON; v22 re-runs the same collision-conditioned arm in the census build through the SHIPPED guarded step, ring and prev-row active: p_detect = 0.808333, CP-95 lower 0.776352, guard-off control 1.000000 (the ring is what separates the trails), 480/480 known-answer gate, guarded k-curve falling to 0.1062 by lag 32. retention_eff = mu * p_detect * p_usable = 1.1 * 0.808333 * 1.0 = 0.8891667; product = 0.3525164; net of the trap debit 5.049e-04 and the density stopping loss 2^-46.0: success.net = 0.3523384 and net CP-95 lower 0.3337161. Both are scored against the 0.39 floor and reported as they land; the production horizon theta = 2^80 is NOT established by a 56-step curve and ships as a named FAILED gate, not as a claim.

REPORTS ARE COUNTED, NOT FORMULAED. 12733 DP-triggered reports over 240 guarded walks = 53.054 per walk against ceil(S/theta) = 64 (ratio 0.829): the count is census-direct and ceil(S/theta) is only a CHECK row. The report cap is factor x mean = 2^46.878 from the measured worst window; no variance bound Var(R) <= E[R] is used, and the v19 Chebyshev row stays withdrawn.

ROUNDING. Every >= and <= literal in the note is a table row checked against its certificate value with a direction rule - a floor literal must satisfy value >= literal, a ceil literal value <= literal - and the old 'at least 0.3963' over 0.3962569 is rejected by that same rule (control shipped). 10 2^x labels are recomputed from their decimals with a planted-flip control. evidence/inequality-audit.json are the machine outputs.

TOY LADDER. 24 full-protocol trials at the shipped fixture (r = 9421, 61-bit p, ord_r(p) = 12, N = 785, table 64 x 12, DP width 2^-5, guard depth 12): plant x, walk the guarded step, end trails at their first DP, store records, solve all twelve shifts on a class-key collision, verify g^x == z. 24/24 pass, steps 30..197; controls: wrong secret rejected, zero-increment trap fires, nonzero-increment pair solves. evidence/ladder-v19.json holds every row.

COST. Per-step counted instructions: 21921 multiply, 13445 squaring = dense Fp12 multiply 20000 + twelve-key selector 1613 + multiply-channel guard 48 + column address 16 + table fetch 72 + label add 28 + key mix 72 + Granger-Scott cyclotomic squaring 11632 (24 Fp mults, 122 Fp adds). One squared fraction f = 3/8. c_raw = 0.937125, c_stress = 0.965333, W_raw = 2^125.727538, W_stress = 2^125.770322. Records are 112 bytes; peak storage 14482615212195472 bytes (term-by-term peak_terms, store<=peak asserted) including the 4 MiB repeat-detector table. Auxiliary work uses ONE GT-exponentiation total: 381 cyclotomic squarings at 11632 instructions + 191 dense multiplies = 412.5896 reference units, charged twice per trail start at the cap.

EVIDENCE. A real-tower toy with the same guarded step: exhaustive census at D=12 with zero joint returns over 26 steps, depth-0 control with 24 two-cycles, 768/768 equivariance checks, 0/384 coalescence splits, 256/256 inverse pairs, 144/144 end-to-end solves, density census 0.7316 at 2^-5, 0.5262 at 2^-7, 0.2778 at 2^-9 with every collision verified. Fixture scale only, no production run. Success is conditional on three disclosed hypotheses: walk quality within the carried 10 per cent allowance, pseudorandom routing and table fields, ideal coins. Four gates fail and ship as failures: the success CP-95 lower is below 0.39, no inversion-free sigma-stable column table exists (UNMET), class-marginal uniformity is refuted at fixture scale (REFUTED, credit not taken), and the class-stream census stops at R = 1024 (UNMET). No novelty claim, no practical break. v21 keeps every v20 row and adds the RELABEL: with z = g^x, the canonical label t = a + x b mod r satisfies g^t = y at every step (25600/25600, 0 failures), so a (t, guard) collision IS an (element, guard) collision; the shipped 48-byte class key is coarser and every element repeat is a key repeat (0 violations). The 1e6-pair census is therefore already the canonical g^a z^b census - 1744 nonzero-increment, 0 zero-increment, all charged - and no numerator moves. The staging path contract is fixed too: the selector names the staged package and every referenced path exists inside the expanded archive.

title: Fixed-G1 into G2 at 125.7711: 128*theta cap implemented and metered (waste = cap x rate x price, no tail), trap expectation by guard monotonicity + Markov on measured E, retention re-measured through the guarded step, reports census-direct, lead 0.0489 over board min 125.82
